title.narrative: Human Rights Defense and environmental justice

description.narrative:
The project aims to strengthen collective protection and the enforceability of human rights, particularly for defenders of the environment, territory, and common goods, with a focus on women and youth. It responds to criminalization, violence, stigmatization, and the lack of public protection policies, as well as the impacts of the extractivist development model on collective rights and environmental justice.
The project builds on existing local and community strengths: networks of defenders, sustainable ancestral practices, previous capacity-building and monitoring initiatives, active participation of women and youth, and strategic alliances with national and international institutions. It seeks to consolidate previous achievements while promoting new actions for collective protection, intersectoral coordination, and public policies that recognize and support the role of rights defenders.
